title: Texas court reopens Houston home ownership dispute after foreclosure and reverse mortgage
summary_full: A Texas appeals court has reopened a lengthy dispute over home ownership in Houston, which has complicated legal issues. The case involves multiple foreclosures, reverse mortgages, and unclear ownership claims spanning twenty-five years. Key questions remain about the validity of a 2011 mortgage after a previous foreclosure occurred in 2001. This ruling requires lower courts to thoroughly examine competing ownership claims before making decisions.
